title: Eagle View Equestrian Center
specs: Indoor arena with LED lighting and large outdoor arena
Jump course and cross country course on site
Release form must be signed before lessons
Proper attire required: long pants, proper footwear, T-shirt or warm clothing
Helmet required for riders under 18; provided for first lesson, must purchase own after
Riders must have horse ready on time; lesson time not extended if late
includes: Use of school horses, tack, and professional riding instruction
Hay, grain twice per day, daily turnout for boarded horses
Indoor and outdoor arenas, round pen, jump and cross country courses
blurb: Guests take horseback riding lessons including private and semi-private options, with riding time plus horsemanship instruction. Training sessions and horse leasing programs are available. Boarding includes stalls and pasture with amenities like indoor arena and daily turnout.
extraNote: Payment due by 1st of month; $20 discount if paid on or before 1st · Rider cancellations require 48 hours notice or lesson forfeited · Trainer cancels only due to weather, horse availability, sickness · Tuition prorated for breaks if coordinated before 1st; lesson spot not reserved if break longer than two weeks
